base.resolution: The request supplied a placeholder rather than a concrete SHA. The branch was created from the source head observed at the initial checkpoint. The source branch later advanced and introduced a shared contract that expressly forbids running while its own source-SHA placeholder remains unreplaced.

blockers: The required source SHA was supplied as <BASE_SHA> rather than an immutable commit.
The shared contract and lane prompt added after source drift still contain {{POST_CURATION_SOURCE_SHA}} and state that the lane must not run until it is replaced.
The source branch drifted from 8b0d26245c1d78fb0be4e79f874a7d8872056ceb to 645e885748c830f7a9cbbbe90ac0f31149bfc81c.
The branch was not and could not be created from a stamped required SHA.
The contract-required early START-RECEIPT.md, private Bun fixture, installed-package guidance reading, probes, raw results, CSV ledgers and checksums were not completed.
The named E04 and E08 raw architecture reports were unavailable at both observed source heads.
The exact requested output branch now exists and force-push is prohibited, so a clean compliant rerun requires a newly authorized branch and path.

keyPreliminaryConclusions: Use Context.Service and explicit root-composed Layers.
Use named Effect.fn for reusable effectful functions and Effect.gen for effect values and local orchestration.
Use Schema.TaggedError for stable expected boundary failures while preserving interruption.
Use Layers and Scopes at the narrowest truthful resource lifetime.
Default to forkChild or scoped fibers; detached work requires explicit host ownership.
Use Clock and DateTime for testable time and explicit zones; use a project-owned versioned PRNG for durable replay.
Use distinct runtime owners for browser windows, service workers, Bun compiler processes, future Cloudflare requests and tests.
Use BrowserRuntime.runMain for the initial interactive page and BunRuntime.runMain for the compiler.
Use ManagedRuntime only at repeated JavaScript-to-Effect boundaries and always give it one disposal owner.
Keep browser storage and network implementations app-local.
Deploy static assets without a Cloudflare Worker until a concrete server responsibility exists.
Pin all Effect ecosystem packages to one exact matching v4 version through the Bun root catalog.
